commitments.detail: Update queue mode from standard to FIFO to prevent reordering during broker failover.
Reduce maximum batch size from 200 to 50 as required by the provider's documented configuration for ordered report delivery.
Reduce report retention from 90 days to exactly 30 days with automatic purge per compliance requirement.
Add immutable audit logging for every report download capturing both the account and the requesting user per compliance requirement.
File the compliance note against this service to formally document the retention and audit logging requirements.
